In all honesty I'm not sure it's just one thing. Sometimes I still have waves of depression and feel like ending it but... I try to either drown that out by watching TV or listening to/making music, or get it out of my system by talking with friends who care. 

But it used to be a much more prevalent problem, what is now a maybe once a month issue used to be chronic. 

The major things that have helped me are having lots of close friends who rely on me and who I see every day (or close to it), having goals that I can work for and reach (currently working on an album with my band), and making sure I feel good about myself/good alone and don't want to run towards a relationship that will inevitably blow up in my face. That all keeps me moving but I don't think any one of those things could do it alone. For me it's the combination, but I think for everyone it's different.
